basic_details.job_title: ITPO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Senior Security Consultant, Security Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO), under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, invites applications from willing and eligible retired Government employees and the Private Sector for 4 contractual posts at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi: 1 Sr. Security Consultant and 3 Security Consultant. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] within three weeks of the Circular's publication on the ITPO website, which is about 2 December 2026 (3 weeks from 11 November 2026).

qualification.details: The pay is a consolidated monthly remuneration, subject to statutory deductions. Retired Government employees who draw pension get a fixed monthly remuneration equal to the last pay drawn minus the basic pension, plus Transport Allowance, as per Department of Expenditure O.M. No 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. There is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. | The notice requires that the health of applicants supports their candidature, with a medical fitness certificate at the time of application and at joining (in case of selection), and a Police Clearance Certificate. It prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

selection_process: All applications received will be scrutinized by a Scrutiny Committee

and the eligibility data of candidates will be tabulated. The scrutinized/shortlisted applicants will be called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee. ITPO reserves the right to accept or reject in part or in full or all the responses without assigning any reasons whatsoever.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual: initially for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, one year at a time depending on requirement within the organisation. Place of posting: India Trade Promotion Organisation, New Delhi. Leave of 8 days a year is allowed on pro-rata basis; absence beyond 8 days in a year means no remuneration, and absence for a continuous 8 days without information or valid reason leads to automatic termination. Working hours are the same as regular Government employees working in ITPO. Attendance is marked in the Biometric Attendance System. No extra remuneration is allowed for work beyond office hours or on Saturdays, Sundays or Gazetted holidays. No TA/DA is admissible for joining or on completion, or for attending interviews or written test. A fixed Transport Allowance for commuting is allowed, not exceeding the rate applicable at the time of retirement. No other facilities such as DA, accommodation, residential phone, conveyance, foreign travel, personal staff, medical reimbursement or CGHS are admissible. TDS is deducted from the monthly remuneration. Selected candidates give integrity certificates from 2 references and a self-declaration of no criminal record or pending criminal case. The consultant is not entitled to absorption or regularization of service. To resign, a consultant gives at least one month's notice or remuneration in lieu, which the Competent Authority may waive in deserving cases. ITPO may terminate any or all consultants at any time without assigning any reason. Consultants are subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and sign the non-disclosure undertaking; an Annual Performance Report is used for appraisal.

content_sections.heading: About ITPO
content_sections.text: India Trade Promotion Organisation is registered under section 25 of the Company Act, 1956 (now Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013). The notice calls it a premier trade promotion agency under the aegis of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, providing a wide spectrum of services to trade and industry. The notice is issued from its Administration Division, E-I Section, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled application in the prescribed format at Annexure-III, together with the Non-Disclosure Undertaking at Annexure-IV, by e-mail to [email protected] . The notice gives no subject line for the email. Applications received after the closing date, by hand or by post will not be accepted under any circumstances. Fill in the application form at Annexure-III, which carries a recent coloured passport size photograph, PAN and Aadhaar details with copies, education, experience and two references. Fill in and sign the Non-Disclosure Undertaking at Annexure-IV, addressed to GM (BM-Coord.) & HoD (Administration). Email both to [email protected] within three weeks of the Circular's publication on the ITPO website. Queries may be sent to the same address, [email protected] . The detailed guidelines of engagement are available on ITPO's career page at https://www.itpo.gov.in/career-at-itpo .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay is a consolidated monthly remuneration, subject to statutory deductions. Retired Government employees who draw pension get a fixed monthly remuneration equal to the last pay drawn minus the basic pension, plus Transport Allowance, as per Department of Expenditure O.M. No 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. There is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. The notice requires that the health of applicants supports their candidature, with a medical fitness certificate at the time of application and at joining (in case of selection), and a Police Clearance Certificate. It prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

Rs.50,000/- a month (applicants not drawing pension)

content_sections.heading: ITPO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of job responsibilities, which applies to both posts: Monitor security activities at Bharat Mandapam premises including parking areas. Ensure safety of vehicles, visitors, and staff. Conduct regular patrols and site inspections of Bharat Mandapam. Manage access control and entry/exit procedures of Bharat Mandapam. Respond to security incidents and emergencies. Coordinate with security guards and parking teams for smooth day top day operations. Operation and maintenance of CCTV system, CCTV footage and report suspicious activities. Maintain security attendance records, daily situational reports and deployment records. Ensure compliance with safety and security procedures. Ensure safety and security arrangements during events/fairs. Liaison with local agencies for security operations. Recommend improvements for parking security and operations.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the Annexure-III format with a recent coloured passport size photograph; separate sheets may be enclosed if needed. PAN No. with copy and Aadhaar No. with copy. Non-Disclosure Undertaking as per Annexure-IV. Medical fitness certificate and Police Clearance Certificate (PCC). For retired Government employees: PPO No. and LPC, with details of last pay drawn, pay level and basic pay. Extra sheets for experience details or additional relevant information, if required.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received will be scrutinized by a Scrutiny Committee, and the eligibility data of candidates will be tabulated. The scrutinized/shortlisted applicants will be called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee. ITPO reserves the right to accept or reject in part or in full or all the responses without assigning any reasons whatsoever.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ITPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 1 Sr. Security Consultant and 3 Security Consultant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ITPO Security Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within three weeks of the Circular's publication on the ITPO website, which is about 2 December 2026 (3 weeks from 11 November 2026). Late applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ITPO Security Consultant?
faq.answer: Both posts need a graduate in any discipline; for Security Consultant, 10th is accepted for Ex ITPO Security candidates. Both posts also need 5 years' service in the listed forces or security cadres, and experience in logistics, event management, administration or security operations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ITPO Security Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 65 years on the date of issue of the advertisement, for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Sr. Security Consultant and Security Consultant at ITPO?
faq.answer: For applicants not drawing pension, Sr. Security Consultant gets Rs.60,000 to 70,000/- depending on experience and Security Consultant gets Rs.50,000/-, as a consolidated monthly remuneration subject to statutory deductions.

faq.question: Q6. How do pensioners' pay get decided at ITPO?
faq.answer: Retired Government employees drawing pension get last pay drawn minus basic pension, plus Transport Allowance, as per Department of Expenditure O.M. No 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ITPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the Annexure-III application and the Annexure-IV Non-Disclosure Undertaking to [email protected]. Hand or postal applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ITPO Security Consultant?
faq.answer: A Scrutiny Committee scrutinizes applications, and shortlisted applicants are called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ITPO Security Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely contractual: initially 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, one year at a time. The consultant is not entitled to absorption or regularization of service.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the ITPO interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA is not payable for attending interviews or a written test, nor for joining or on completion of the assignment.
